phases: Phase 1: pin the double-count -- NEW tests/test_escalation_supersedes.py building an event and its escalation from the shape sweep appends, calling collapsed_severity, with controls for an unescalated event, an orphan escalation, and a closed escalation returning the original to the count.
Phase 2: skip superseded originals in the sum -- collapsed_severity computes a superseded set from live escalations' source_entry_id and skips members; no addressed flag is written.
ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_signature_discrimination.py tests/test_remediation_closure_states.py tests/test_shadow_residue_disposition.py tests/test_remediate.py -q

limitations: Bounds the measure; does not clear the breach. Projected ceiling 55 -> 40; 40 is genuine debt and the gate correctly keeps firing.
non_goals: No recalibration of THRESHOLD: a constant cannot bound a monotonically non-decreasing quantity, which is what the projection showed.
exclusions: No change to the escalation rule, stale-expiry, _signature, THRESHOLD, STALE_DAYS, or orchestration_override.
No event written, mutated or closed; read-side filter only, no addressed flag touched.
